test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who inaugurated the new Durbar Hall at Raj Bhavan in Malabar Hill, Mumbai in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Ram Nath Kovind.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The President of India at that time, **Shri Ram Nath Kovind** **inaugurated **the new** Darbar Hall at Raj Bhavan, Mumbai on February 11, 2022.**
 
• Ram Nath **Kovind **presided as** India's 14th President from 2017 to 2022.**
 
 
• He is the** first Uttar Pradeshi to hold the office of President of India.**
 
• Prior to his presidency, he served as the **26th Governor of Bihar from 2015 to 2017.**
 
• From 1994 to 2006, he was a member of the Rajya Sabha as well.
